settings.item_headline: Gold, Platinum, Boosts — all of it is making it worse, not better.
settings.item_body:
I dropped close to €500 in one year. Gold first. Then Platinum at €40+ a month. Then Boosts on top. Got 11 matches. Eleven. Out of thousands of right swipes.

Here's the part nobody tells you.

Tinder runs an internal score on every profile — basically an ELO — based on right-swipes vs left-swipes. Once you're rated low, the app shows you to fewer women. The women it does show you to are also rated low.

Now look at what a Boost actually does. It takes a low-rated profile and forces it in front of more people for 30 minutes. Those people see the same profile that's already been getting left-swiped. They left-swipe it too. Your score drops further. Now you're rated lower than when you started, and the app shows you to even fewer women.

You paid €40 to accelerate the descent.

Same logic on Platinum's priority likes. You're not buying matches. You're buying more visibility on a profile that hasn't been fixed. More visibility on a broken profile = more left-swipes = lower score.

You can't pay your way out of the algorithm. You have to fix what made it rate you low in the first place.
settings.item_image_alt: Apple receipt showing recurring Tinder Platinum and Boost charges

settings.item_headline: Nobody reads your bio. Stop rewriting it.
settings.item_body:
I rewrote mine 40 times. Funny version. Sincere version. Mysterious version. Added "6'0". Added hobbies, removed hobbies. Tried being a guy with a dog. Tried being a guy without a dog.

Zero of it moved anything.

Because the decision to swipe gets made off your first photo, in roughly half a second. Bios get opened maybe 5–10% of the time — and almost always only on profiles she's already decided to swipe right on.

You're not getting filtered because of your bio. You're getting filtered before she reads a single word of it.

So stop rewriting it. That's not what's broken.
settings.item_image_alt: Eye-tracking heatmap on a Tinder profile showing focus on photo, not bio

settings.item_headline: The decision happens in 0.5 seconds — and she's not looking where you think she is.
settings.item_body:
Eye-tracking studies on dating apps show the same result every time. Women lock onto one specific area first: the face. Inside the face, specifically the jaw and chin.

The decision happens in roughly half a second. Before your body. Before your height. Before your outfit. Before the dog.

I read this and pulled up my own profile. First photo was a 3/4 angle. You couldn't see my jaw in it at all. Sat with that for a minute.

If your face doesn't pass that half-second filter, nothing else in your profile gets seen. Not one word. Not one photo. Not the gym pic you spent 20 minutes picking.

Which raises the only question that matters: what is she actually seeing in that half second?
settings.item_image_alt: Eye-tracking heatmap on a male face showing concentration on jaw and chin

settings.item_headline: Modern men have the softest jaws in history. The gym guys included.
settings.item_body:
Look at photos of soldiers, athletes, manual laborers from 60 years ago. Sharp jaws across the board. Skinny, heavy, didn't matter.

Now look at modern guys with serious physiques. Soft jaws. Round faces. Body of a soldier, face of a baby.

The reason is mechanical. We grew up on soft food. Bread. Ground meat. Smoothies. Protein shakes. Oats. The masseter — the main muscle along the jaw — never gets loaded.

Same principle as never training chest.

No load. No muscle.

Soft food. Soft face.

Doesn't matter how shredded the rest of you is. If the jaw has never been trained, the face stays soft. And her eyes skip past you in half a second.

This was the part I felt stupid about. 8 years in the gym, training every muscle in my body, and I'd skipped the one that was deciding whether anyone ever saw me.
settings.item_image_alt: Side-by-side, 1950s soldier portrait vs modern lifter side profile

settings.item_headline: The fix: train the jaw muscle with actual resistance. This is the one that worked.
settings.item_body:
Once I figured out the problem was the masseter, I tried everything.

  • Mewing — 3 months of holding my tongue against the roof of my mouth. Nothing visibly changed. Also realistically impossible to maintain all day.
  • Mastic gum — tastes like a pine forest. Quit after 4 days.
  • Silicone jaw balls — look like a sex toy. Not pulling one out at my desk.
  • Filler / chin surgery — €2,000 and permanent. Hard no.

Then I found GUMFORCE.

It's a gum engineered to be 10x harder than regular gum. Regular gum has the consistency of marshmallow — you could chew it 12 hours a day and your face would not change. GUMFORCE forces the masseter to actually work every time you chew. Same principle as putting a heavier dumbbell in your hand. Heavier load, muscle adapts.

It also has 500mg of creatine per piece. I take creatine anyway. This stacks on top of my regular scoop. No extra step, no extra effort, no extra supplement to remember.

And the part that mattered most for me: you use it anywhere. At your desk. In the car. On a walk. In a meeting. Nobody knows you're training. No device. No mirror. No 12-step morning routine. You chew gum.

8 weeks in, my face was visibly sharper. The gap between my body and my face closed. I started looking like one consistent guy in photos instead of a built body with a soft face stuck on top.

3 dates the first month I was consistent with it. 11 matches in the two months after.

settings.hero_headline: 5 reasons you're getting zero matches on Tinder (the last one is the only thing that ever actually moved mine)
settings.recap_block:
My story: 5 months of zero matches. €500 burned in the app. 40 bio rewrites. 8 years in the gym. None of it moved the needle. One change did.

Here are the 5 things I figured out, in the order I wish someone had laid them out for me at 22.
settings.guarantee_text: 90-day guarantee. Chew it for 90 days. If your face hasn't visibly changed and you're not getting more matches, send back what's left of the pouch, full refund, no return shipping.
settings.closer_paragraph:
One last thing.

If you're under 35 and you've burned money on Gold, Platinum, Boosts, photos, bio rewrites, and the gym, and nothing's worked — this is the thing nobody on the dating subs will tell you.

They all just say "go to the gym bro."

I went to the gym for 8 years.

It didn't fix my face.

Train the jaw. Same way you train everything else.
